operation_details.item: The user's Client A runs its finance systems on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning—how’s the client work looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty steady. I’m reviewing the system details before we discuss process improvements.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you looking at the finance systems across the client profiles?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. Client A runs its finance systems on SAP, Client B uses Oracle, and Client C uses NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a useful starting point. The platform differences may shape where process changes are easiest to implement.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’m trying to keep the discussion practical rather than force the same approach across all three clients.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that Client A runs on SAP, while keeping the system details for Clients B and C.
